notes.title: Free content update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36687884/2b14733c5fed1a51dd882bee3ce34d1a82b79dc4.pngHello everyone! I thought it would be cool to find a way to add some of the unused art into the game, so I made this small update that adds a bonus scene at the end of the game! Simply click "Bonus Scene" at the end to view it. I hope you enjoy it!

Also I have a twitter account now, please check it out: https://twitter.com/sigyaad
